A third call to action beside the two that exist, in Header, Hero, FinalCta and Footer. Same-origin, like the others.

marketing-cta.test.ts currently asserts that each of those components links to /chat and mentions no hey.chattic.us host. Extend it rather than working around it — the guard exists because a marketing CTA pointing at the wrong origin has broken before.

**Done when:** the scenario exists and fails for the right reason.
